funding_notes: airbnb.com; HQ San Francisco; founded 2008 (YC W09; ~$600K Sequoia seed 2009). Rounds: Series A $7.2M (Nov 2010, Sequoia & Greylock), Series B $112M (Jul 2011, a16z), Series D ~$450M (2014, TPG; reported $450M-$500M, $10B valuation), Series E $1.5B (2015, $25.5B), Series F ~$1.003B closed Mar 2017 at $31B (CapitalG & TCV). Apr 2020: $1B from Silver Lake & Sixth Street in mixed debt + equity (equity split not disclosed; excluded). IPO on Nasdaq (ABNB) Dec 10, 2020 at $68/share, ~$3.7B gross (excluded from total). Series C (~2012) and seed not itemized; list may not be exhaustive. amount_raised sums the five listed equity rounds.
